concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- Ansible is agentless — uses only SSH with no software required on target servers
- Terraform provisions infrastructure Ansible configures what was just provisioned
- YAML indentation is critical — use exactly 2 spaces and never use tabs in YAML
- Ansible is idempotent — running the same playbook twice produces the same result
- 90 percent of Fortune 500 companies use Ansible for configuration management daily
